blocks.title: Smog
blocks.text: Smog hawa ki aaloodgi ki woh qism hai jis ki pehchan ghani dhund hai. Yeh zyada tar shehri ilaqon mein hoti hai aur gariyon, sanat aur doosre zaraye ke ikhraj se banti hai; yeh bareek dhool ya kajal ke zarraat, jame pani ke bukharat, SO2, NOx, O3, CO aur CO2 jaisi zehreeli gases, ozone jaise secondary pollutants, bina jale hydrocarbons, VOCs aur 10 se 2.5 micrometres ke particulate matter par mushtamil hai (Figure 14.3, Lahore Fort ke gird smog).

Is ki do qismein hain. Classical ya sulfurous smog, jise industrial, reducing ya London smog bhi kehte hain, hawa mein sulfur oxides ki bari miqdaron ke chhorne se banti hai. Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) tab banti hai jab nitrogen oxides, VOC aur bina jale hydrocarbons jaise primary pollutants dhoop mein photochemical reactions se ozone aur peroxyacetyl nitrates (PAN) jaise secondary pollutants banate hain (Figure 14.4); ise zyada khatarnak samjha jata hai, kyunke yeh dil ki dharkan ki be-qaidgi, pneumonia aur yahan tak ke phephron ka cancer kar sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: classical aur photochemical smog ka wajah, doosre naam, products aur nuqsan se muqabla karti table, smog ki tarkeeb ke saath. Oopar daen: acid rain ke teen muadle aur tezabi qatre kaise safar karte aur girte hain. Neeche baen: sooraj, sabz zameeni satah tak pohnchti chhoti-mauj shuaein, aur lambi-mauj infrared ka kuch hissa nikalta aur kuch greenhouse gases ki nuqtedar tah se wapas aata hua khaka. Neeche daen: fossil fuels jalane aur jangal katne ke asrat.
blocks.caption: Smog ki do qismein, acid rain aur greenhouse effect, insani asrat ke saath (Figures 14.2 se 14.5 aur topics 14.5 se 14.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Classical smog coal jalane wale shehron ki reducing, sulfurous dhund hai, jabke photochemical smog woh oxidising dhund hai jo nitrogen oxides aur volatile organics ke dhoop mein react kar ke ozone aur peroxyacetyl nitrate dene se banti hai. Fuels ki sulfur dioxide trioxide mein oxidise ho kar sulfuric acid ke taur par halti hai, aur nitrogen dioxide nitric aur nitrous acids deti hai, to taqreeban 5 se kam pH ki barish hawa ke rukh par door girti aur imarton aur ecosystems ko galati hai. Greenhouse effect is liye hota hai ke carbon dioxide, pani ke bukharat aur doosri gases chhoti-mauj dhoop ko zameen garam karne ke liye guzarne deti hain magar raat ko zameen se nikalne wali lambi-mauj garmi jazb kar leti hain, to in gases ki barhti concentration aalmi darja hararat barhati hai. Fossil fuels jalana aur jangal saaf karna woh insani sargarmiyan hain jo in sab ko chalati hain.

blocks.prompt: Classical aur photochemical smog mein farq batayein, aur kahein ke photochemical smog kin halaat mein banti hai (Quick Check 14.3a; exercise Q.2g; MCQ I, XII).
blocks.explanation: Classical smog coal jalne se sulfur dioxide, kajal aur dhund ka reducing mixture hai, purane London jaise thande, nam sardi ke shehron ki khaas. Photochemical smog oxidising hai: tez dhoop mein traffic ke nitrogen oxides aur VOCs react kar ke ozone aur PAN dete hain, to yeh bhari traffic wale shehron mein garam, dhoop wale, sakin dinon mein banti hai; bhoora rang NO2 se aata hai aur us ki bunyadi pehchan PAN ke saath ozone hai.

items: Smog: kajal, pani ke qatron, SO2, NOx, O3, CO, CO2, hydrocarbons, VOCs aur PM10-2.5 ki ghani shehri dhund. Classical (London): SOx, reducing. Photochemical (Los Angeles): dhoop mein NOx + VOCs O3 aur PAN dete hain; oxidising; zyada khatarnak.
